items.source_text: On 9 June 2014, at a press conference hosted by the Xiamen City State Chamber of Commerce on the “three main projects of civil promotion on both sides of the Taiwan Straits” in Xiamen City, the director of Jiangsu Hoang Poon Investment Ltd. Chen Guangpao announced in Xiamen that he was willing to contribute $1.5 billion to support the construction of the Golden Bridge. Taiwan Guangcai Industries Ltd. signed an overall framework agreement for the three projects, and Chen Guanghuo signed a strategic framework agreement with Taiwan's Guangcai Golden and Peace Bridge Equity Corporation to set up the Golden Peace Bridge BOT Project and take the lead in the allocation of $1.5 billion.

translations.baseline: 2014年6月9日，厦门市台商投资企业协会在厦门召开的“两岸民间交流交往‘三通’重点项目”新闻发布会上，江苏皇甫投资有限公司董事长陈广福在厦门宣布，愿意出资150亿元支持金门大桥的建设。台湾广彩实业有限公司与“三通”重点项目签约，陈广福与台湾广彩金门和平大桥股份有限公司签订战略框架合作协议，成立金门和平大桥BOT项目公司，陈广福将率先出资150亿元。
translations.opd: 2014年6月9日，厦门市政府商会主办的“两岸民间推广三大项目”新闻发布会上，江苏黄邦投资有限公司董事长陈光宝在厦门宣布愿意出资15亿美元支持金桥建设。台湾广彩工业有限公司签署了三大项目的总体框架协议，陈光宝与台湾广彩金和平桥股权投资公司签署了战略框架协议，设立金和平桥BOT项目，并率先分配了15亿美元。

items.source_text: In 1859, the British scholar Charles Darwin, in The Origins of Nature, began with an evolutionary theory based on natural selection, probably the most visible in science and far-reaching theory. In the early 1900s, various animals were rediscovered in the legacy law developed by the Austrian monk Grigg Mundler in 1866, and the legacy became the dominant object of research after a long period of natural progress, even by humans. Mondler’s law was the starting point of genetic research, which was also one of the leading researches in science and industry and deeply influenced the public’s understanding of “the place of human beings in the universe.” By 1953, James Watson, Frances Crick and Rosalyn Franklin were rediscovered, and then became the main source of research.

items.source_text: Distributed operating system (distributed operating system) is a software that is many independent, network-connected, communicable, and physically separated combinations of computing nodes. Each node contains a specific software subset of the global master operating system. Each software subset is a composite of two different services. The first service is a universal minimum inner core, or micronuclear, directly controlling the hardware of the node. The second service is a higher assembly of independent and coordinated activity system management components at the coordinating node. These components are abstract micronuclear functions and support user applications.

items.source_text: Albania, commonly known as Albania, is a country in the south-eastern part of Europe, south-west of the Balkan half-island. Albania is west of the Adriatic Sea and the Otranto Straits to Italy, bordering Greece to the south, north of Macedonia to the east, bordering Kosovo to the north-east, and Montenegro to the north. The capital is Tirana, with its international code AL. During the Cold War, Albania was a socialist country.

items.source_text: On June 12, 2003, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs held a press conference in which it officially announced that the passport had been issued as of September 1 2003 and that the passport had been issued under the symbol "TAIWAN". Chen Shui-bian government decided to add the name "TAIWAN" between the seal and the "passport" in order to show the difference between the Chinese and the Chinese People's Republic of China, so that Taiwan tourists outside the country would not be mistaken for the Republic of China's Republic of China, so that it would be wrong to believe that it would be inappropriate to use a visa-free visa to block the boarding of the plane, so that the people of the Chinese People's Republic of China could clearly say that they were from Taiwan, not China, that they were from China, in order to avoid being harassed by the ban on entry or the people of China outside the country.

translations.baseline: 2003年6月12日，外交部舉行記者會，正式宣布自2003年9月1日起，護照簽發改用「TAIWAN」標示，護照封面標示「TAIWAN」。陳水扁政府為區分中華民國與中華人民共和國，決定在護照封面上加註「TAIWAN」，以示區別，使台灣國外遊客不會被誤認為是中華人民共和國國民，而被拒絕入境，造成不便，因此在護照上加註「TAIWAN」，以使中華民國國民能清楚表明自己是來自台灣，而非中國，以避免被中華人民共和國政府禁止入境或國外遊客受到排擠。
translations.opd: 2003年6月12日，外交部举行新闻发布会，正式宣布护照自2003年9月1日起签发，并在护照上使用“TAIWAN”字样。陈水扁政府决定在印章和“护照”之间添加“TAIWAN”字样，以显示与中華人民共和國的区别，使台湾游客在海外不会被误认为是中华民国公民，因此使用免签签证登机是不合适的，这样可以避免被禁止入境或海外华人受到骚扰。

items.source_text: Restructures because the very limited programming instruction promotes editing that meets current needs only and is done as simple as possible. Sometimes a rigid system is encountered, one of which is that it requires double (or multiple) maintenance: a change of function requires a change in multiple (or similar) codes; another is that changes to parts of the code affect many other parts. The XP doctrine suggests that when this happens, the system is telling you that by changing the architecture of the system, it will be made simpler and more general.

translations.baseline:
重构
因为非常有限的编程指令促进只满足当前需求的编辑，而且尽可能简单地完成。有时会遇到一个僵硬的系统，其中的一个是它需要双倍（或多重）维护：改变功能需要改变多个（或类似的）代码；另一个是改变代码的某部分影响许多其他部分。XP教条建议当这种情况发生时，系统在告诉你通过改变系统的架构，它将被简化和变得更通用。

items.source_text: Semiconductor semiconductor products from Texas instruments account for almost 85% of their revenue (2003 data). They are in the lead in different product areas, including digital signal processors, digital analogue converters, analogue digital converters, energy management, simulation of integrated circuits, etc. Wireless communication is also a focus of Texas instruments, with about 50% of the world's mobile phones now equipped with chips from Texas instruments.

items.source_text: Game engines provide a range of visual development tools and reusable components. By integrating them into the development environment, these tools allow developers to develop simple and fast data-driven game development. In order to increase the efficiency of game developers ' development, engine developers develop a large number of software components required for the game. Most engines are integrated into functional components such as graphics, sound, physics and artificial intelligence. The engines are called "intermediate" because they can provide flexible and reuse platforms that provide game developers with all the core functions they need, thus saving large amounts of game development costs, reducing the complexity of the development and reducing the time spent on the market, all of which are key factors for the highly competitive game industry. Engines such as the vanity series, Unity3D, Frostbite Engineering, Zerodin, Doom3, CryENGINE, 3DGame Studio, RenderWare, Gamebriyo, Virtools, RE and Source engines.

translations.baseline: 游戏引擎提供了一系列的视觉开发工具和可重用的组件。通过将这些工具集成到开发环境中，这些工具允许开发人员进行简单快速的数据驱动游戏开发。为了提高游戏开发人员的开发效率，引擎开发者开发了大量的游戏所需软件组件。大多数引擎都集成了图形、声音、物理和人工智能等功能组件。引擎被称为“中间件”，因为它们可以提供灵活的、可重用的平台，为游戏开发人员提供他们所需的所有核心功能，从而节省了大量的游戏开发成本，降低了开发的复杂性，减少了上市时间，这些都是竞争激烈的游戏产业的关键因素。著名的引擎有虚幻系列、Unity3D、Frostbite工程、Crytek、id Tech、Doom3、CryENGINE、3DGameStudio、RenderWare、Gamebryo、Virtools、RE引擎和Source引擎等。

items.source_text: While the United Kingdom, Poland, the Republic of Korea, and Italy initially supported their retention, the four countries did not support Gali after the United States made clear that it would exercise its veto power on the United Nations Security Council. Although Gali was not the first Secretary-General to be vetoed, he remained the first Secretary-General in the history of the United Nations to be re-elected for two consecutive terms.

As a result, NOD and GDI were engaged in a contemporary world war in the game.

items.source_text: After his death in 1936, his reputation became increasingly mythic. But more strikingly, the author of Rujn’s writings was the largest contemporary Chinese writer: memoirs, biography, writings about his work and ideas, and, in the last six years of his life, he was the cultural icon of the left-wing newspaper. items.source_text: Within hours of Mac OS X Leopard’s release, the community of OSx86 quickly followed up on the kernel modification and released the kernel repair program of AMD/Intel SSE2/3, now known as the EFI Extendable Interface (UEFI), which is a software interface between the operating system and the platform’s fixture. This method does not need to obtain and modify the macos source document, which is considered the best legal way to install macos on non-apple computers.

items.source_text: After the Japanese invasion, the banks withdrew from the occupied areas and took away all their capital and undistributed currency. The Japanese military government quickly established the Banco Zanan on 27 September 1937, exercising its power to issue money. When the puppet regime was formed, the authorities merged the Banco Zanan with the three smaller local banks, namely, the Banco Zanan Fong, the Zaying City Officer ' s Bureau of Money, and the Bank Shining Tong, to establish the Monjiang Bank.

translations.baseline:
历史
满洲国时期，满洲国政府于1932年12月1日成立满洲中央银行，发行满洲国货币。日本侵华后，满洲中央银行撤出占领区，带走所有资本和未发行的货币。日军占领区的伪满政府很快于1937年9月27日成立满洲南满银行，行使发行货币的权力。当傀儡政权成立后，当局将满洲南满银行与另外三家较小的地方性银行合并，即满洲南满银行奉天分行、齐齐哈尔市官吏局银行、银行盛京通商银行，成立满洲蒙疆银行。
translations.opd: 日本入侵后，银行从被占领地区撤出，并带走了所有资本和未分配的货币。日本军事政府于1937年9月27日迅速成立了扎南银行，行使发行货币的权力。当傀儡政权成立时，当局将扎南银行与三家较小的当地银行合并，即扎南丰银行、扎宜城官署货币局和银行盛通，成立了满江银行。

items.source_text: The buffer zone has no legacy value, but as a core protective zone and a general zone, it limits development within the zone. Moreover, it is not included in the buffer zone, but in areas that may have an impact, and the World Heritage Committee believes that it also needs to be managed. For example, the debris building near the British Tower of London is not in the buffer zone, but its height over 300 metres has affected the view of the Tower, and the World Heritage Committee has expressed its concern, but has not taken any further steps.

translations.baseline: 缓冲区没有遗产价值，但作为核心区和一般区，它限制了区内发展。此外，缓冲区不包括在内，但位于可能产生影响的地区，世界遗产委员会认为它也需要管理。例如，伦敦塔附近的废料建筑不在缓冲区内，但其高度超过300米，影响了塔的视野，世界遗产委员会对此表示了担忧，但没有采取进一步的行动。

items.source_text: "Google Desktop" is not an open source, free software, but a user can download and use it free of charge, subject to the end-user usage terms (EULA). When installed, the "Google Desktop" takes hundreds of MB space and a certain amount of time to create an index and is automatically activated every time you open it in order to achieve a search function for local resources. Users can also freely turn the software off and delete it.

items.source_text: Benn's capital (which is a private equity investment company in the United States) was founded in 1984 by three partners, Mit Romney, the parent company Bann's strategic advisor, based in Boston, Boston, United States, with branches in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Tokyo, New York, London, and Munich. Benn's capital is an international private equity investment fund with investments in a range of industry and geographical areas, including private equity, venture capital, credit, public equity, influential investments, life sciences, and real estate. items.source_text: After that, the country could nominate from the list, and the World Heritage Center would advise and assist in the preparation of the nomination form. The nomination form submitted to the World Heritage Centre would first be independently reviewed by the International Council of Cultural Monuments and History (ICOMOS) and the World Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and the evaluation of the report would be sent to the World Heritage Committee. items.source_text: Under Prime Minister Zhou Enlai's protection of “emancipation” in October 1968, five documents, such as “10 articles of power expansion” and “Specific provisions for expanding the management autonomy of State-owned enterprises” were issued by the State Council and implemented in person by the State Council in November 1969. These documents were the first to expand the autonomy of enterprises in China from June 1970 to March 1978, which led to the opening of the business reform process. From 1977 onwards, the State Council appointed the Director of the National Economic Commission and the Deputy Secretary of the Party.

items.source_text: In Taiwan, there are 12 years of national teaching in the current school system. There are six years of primary education, three years of secondary education, three years of higher secondary education (including high-level vocational schools), four years of general university, five years of law, five years of construction, five years of veterinary medicine, six years of dental medicine and six years of medical science. There are five years of specialized technical education schools (five specialties), two years of special studies (two specialties), two years of technical college (two-year technical school) and four years of science and technology university and technical college (four specialties), and universities and universities of science and technology (four specialties).

translations.baseline: 臺灣目前的學制為十二年國民教育。其中小學六年、國民中學三年、高級中學三年（含高級職業學校），一般大學四年、法學五年、建築學五年、獸醫學五年、牙醫學六年、醫學六年。專門技術學院（五年制五專）、專科學校（二年制二專）、技術學院（二年制二專）及科技大學與專科學校（四年制四專）等專門職業教育。
translations.opd: 在台湾，现行学校体系中有12年的国民教育。其中，小学6年，初中3年，高中3年（包括高级职业学校），大学4年，法律5年，建筑5年，兽医5年，牙科6年，医学6年。还有5年专科技术学校（5个专业），2年特殊研究（2个专业），2年技术学院（2年制技术学校），以及4年科技大学和科技学院（4个专业），还有大学和科技学院（4个专业）。

items.source_text: Although the gene contains all the information needed for the function of the organism, the environment still plays an important role in determining the ultimate shape of the organism; this duality is called the “kind and the future”, and it can also be said that a organism behaves in a low-temperature environment that is dependent on genetic interaction. An example of this interaction is a temperature-sensitive mutation: changes in the individual amino acid in the protein sequence usually do not change the behaviour of the protein and its interaction with other molecules, but they can cause instability in the protein structure. In a high-temperature environment, the accelerated movement of molecules and the increased collision of molecules can lead to the destruction of the protein structure, rendering it incapable of performing its functions; in a low-temperature environment, the protein structure can remain stable and able to perform normal functions. Such mutation can be observed in Siamese cat fur.

translations.baseline: 虽然基因包含了生物体功能所需的所有信息，环境仍然在决定生物体最终形态中起着重要作用；这种二元性被称为“本性和后天”，也可以说生物体的行为是依赖于基因与环境的相互作用。这种相互作用的一个例子是温度敏感突变：蛋白质序列中单个氨基酸的变化通常不会改变蛋白质的行为及其与其他分子的相互作用，但可以导致蛋白质结构的不稳定。在高温环境中，分子的加速运动和分子碰撞的增加会导致蛋白质结构的破坏，使其无法执行其功能；在低温环境中，蛋白质结构可以保持稳定并能够执行正常功能。这种突变可以在暹罗猫的毛色中观察到。

items.source_text: In 1940, the third division of the waiting room was set up, with Chen Gov as its director, and Xiao Xanyu as its deputy director. After the withdrawal of the service to Wuhan in 1938, the staff of the first group was handed over to the third division. The group became responsible for foreign affairs administration. It was also directly connected with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The staff of the fifth group was not numerous, with only one or two secretaries. Shen Chang-hwan and Xing were also appointed as secretaries of the group. The stenctuaries were also included in the composition of the group. The sixth group (Sentage Six) was set up to report operations within the group, after the withdrawal of Chiang Kai-shek to Wu-han in 1938, and, as a result of the growing complexity of the information sources and his personal mastership, Zhang was assigned six teams in the chamber, and the army secretary of the army was also responsible for research and operations of the Japanese army.

translations.baseline: 1940年，特务三处成立，处长为陈恭澍，副处长为萧乾。1938年迁往武汉后，第一组的人员移交给了特务三处。该组负责对外交事务的管理。同时，该组也直接与外交部联系。该组的人员不多，只有1、2名秘书。沈昌焕和萧乾也兼任该组的秘书。该组的机要秘书也列入了该组的编制。第六组（机要六组）成立，负责在该组内部报告工作情况，由于情报来源日益复杂，张冲个人掌握情报的难度加大，于是张冲在机要六组中指派了6人，负责日军的情报搜集和研究工作。

items.source_text: On 21 December 1988, following the Lockerbie crash, the Libyan government was accused of harbouring the perpetrators, and in 1991 the United Nations, under international pressure led by the United Kingdom and the United States, imposed a series of sanctions on Libya, including air blockades, the ban on the movement of force, economic and diplomatic sanctions. In 1999, Libya agreed to hand over two suspects to the United Nations for trial.

items.source_text: In March 2023, the Ministry of Culture and Science published the results of the validation of the primary school textbooks that were used in 2024. Of these, all three textbooks for the fifth grade of primary school “social” refer to the North as “inherent territory” of Japan, namely, the Nanjing massacre and “recruited labour” in all three classes of “social” subjects.

translations.baseline: 2023年3月，文部科学省公布了2024年度起使用的中小学教科书审定结果。其中，小学五年级“社会”科目三套教科书均将南京大屠杀和“强制劳工”记述为日本“固有领土”相关事件。日本政府在2023年4月1日的内阁会议上通过了2023年度预算案，其中防卫费创历史新高，达到约6.8万亿日元。

items.source_text: On 10 January 2002, a number of banks and financial institutions began issuing bank cards in five cities, namely Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hangzhou, and Shenzhen, with Silver Union logos, which were gradually extended to the entire Chinese mainland. On 18 October 2005, the China Silver Federation launched a new logo, fine-tuning local elements such as the size of the old three-colour blocks and the tilting of the oblique and adding English-language Unionpay.

translations.baseline: 2002年1月10日，多家银行和金融机构开始在北京市、上海市、广州市、杭州市、深圳市五个城市发行银联标志的银行卡，之后逐渐扩展到整个中国大陆。2005年10月18日，中国银联推出新版标识，对旧版三色块的大小、斜度等地方元素进行微调，并加入英文Unionpay。2006年1月1日，中国银联正式启用新版标识。

《中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法》第二条（2003年12月27日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议通过，2006年10月31日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十四次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法〉的决定》修正）：“国务院银行业监督管理机构负责对全国银行业金融机构及其业务活动监督管理的工作。本法所称银行业金融机构，是指在中华人民共和国境内设立的商业银行、城市信用合作社、农村信用合作社等吸收公众存款的金融机构以及政策性银行。对在中华人民共和国境内设立的金融资产管理公司、信托投资公司、财务公司、金融租赁公司以及经国务院银行业监督管理机构批准设立的其他金融机构的监督管理，适用本法对银行业金融机构监督管理的规定。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照本法第十三条的规定，审查批准银行业金融机构的设立、变更、终止以及业务范围。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照法律、行政法规制定银行业金融机构的审慎经营规则。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照法律、行政法规规定的条件和程序，审查批准银行业金融机构的设立、变更、终止以及业务范围。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照法律、行政法规规定的条件，审查批准银行业金融机构的设立、变更、终止，以及业务范围内的业务品种。银行业金融机构的审慎经营规则，由国务院银行业监督管理机构根据法律、行政法规制定。国务院银行业监督管理机构根据履行职责的需要，可以与银行业金融机构的董事、高级管理人员进行监督管理谈话，要求银行业金融机构董事、高级管理人员就银行业金融机构的业务活动和风险管理的重大事项作出说明。银行业金融机构有违法经营、经营管理不善等情形，不予撤销将严重危害金融秩序、损害公众利益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权予以撤销。银行业金融机构已经或者可能发生信用危机，严重影响存款人和其他客户合法权益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构可以依法对该银行业金融机构实行接管或者促成机构重组，接管和机构重组依照有关法律和国务院的规定执行。银行业金融机构被接管、重组或者被撤销的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权要求该银行业金融机构的董事、高级管理人员和其他工作人员，按照国务院银行业监督管理机构的要求履行职责。在接管、机构重组或者撤销清算期间，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，对直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员，可以采取下列措施：（一）直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员出境将对国家利益造成重大损失的，通知出境管理机关依法阻止其出境；（二）申请司法机关禁止其转移、转让财产或者对其财产设定其他权利。银行业金融机构违反审慎经营规则的，国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构应当责令限期改正；逾期未改正的，或者其行为严重危及该银行业金融机构的稳健运行、损害存款人和其他客户合法权益的，经国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构负责人批准，可以区别情形，采取下列措施：（一）责令暂停部分业务、停止批准开办新业务；（二）限制分配红利和其他收入；（三）限制资产转让；（四）责令控股股东转让股权或者限制有关股东的权利；（五）责令调整董事、高级管理人员或者限制其权利；（六）停止批准增设分支机构。银行业金融机构有违法经营、经营管理不善等情形，不予撤销将严重危害金融秩序、损害公众利益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权予以撤销。银行业金融机构已经或者可能发生信用危机，严重影响存款人和其他客户合法权益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构可以依法对该银行业金融机构实行接管或者促成机构重组，接管和机构重组依照有关法律和国务院的规定执行。银行业金融机构被接管、重组或者被撤销的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权要求该银行业金融机构的董事、高级管理人员和其他工作人员，按照国务院银行业监督管理机构的要求履行职责。在接管、机构重组或者撤销清算期间，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，对直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员，可以采取下列措施：（一）直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员出境将对国家利益造成重大损失的，通知出境管理机关依法阻止其出境；（二）申请司法机关禁止其转移、转让财产或者对其财产设定其他权利。银行业金融机构违反审慎经营规则的，国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构应当责令限期改正；逾期未改正的，或者其行为严重危及该银行业金融机构的稳健运行、损害存款人和其他客户合法权益的，经国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构负责人批准，可以区别情形，采取下列措施：（一）责令暂停部分业务、停止批准开办新业务；（二）限制分配红利和其他收入；（三）限制资产转让；（四）责令控股股东转让股权或者限制有关股东的权利；（五）责令调整董事、高级管理人员或者限制其权利；（六）停止批准增设分支机构。银行业金融机构有违法经营、经营管理不善等情形，不予撤销将严 中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法（2003年12月27日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议通过，根据2006年10月31日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十四次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法〉的决定》修正）第二条：“国务院银行业监督管理机构负责对全国银行业金融机构及其业务活动监督管理的工作。本法所称银行业金融机构，是指在中华人民共和国境内设立的商业银行、城市信用合作社、农村信用合作社等吸收公众存款的金融机构以及政策性银行。对在中华人民共和国境内设立的金融资产管理公司、信托投资公司、财务公司、金融租赁公司以及经国务院银行业监督管理机构批准设立的其他金融机构的监督管理，适用本法对银行业金融机构监督管理的规定。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照本法第十三条的规定，审查批准银行业金融机构的设立、变更、终止以及业务范围。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照本法第十四条的规定，审查批准银行业金融机构的董事和高级管理人员的任职资格。银行业金融机构的业务范围由国务院银行业监督管理机构依照本法第十四条的规定确定。国务院银行业监督管理机构对银行业金融机构的董事和高级管理人员实行任职资格管理。具体办法由国务院银行业监督管理机构制定。国务院银行业监督管理机构根据履行职责的需要，可以与银行业金融机构董事、高级管理人员进行监督管理谈话，要求银行业金融机构董事、高级管理人员就银行业金融机构的业务活动和风险管理的重大事项作出说明。国务院银行业监督管理机构依法对银行业金融机构进行检查时，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，可以询问银行业金融机构的工作人员，要求其对有关检查事项作出说明。国务院银行业监督管理机构依法对银行业金融机构进行检查时，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，可以查阅、复制银行业金融机构与检查事项有关的文件、资料，对可能被转移、隐匿或者毁损的文件、资料可以予以封存。国务院银行业监督管理机构依法对银行业金融机构进行检查时，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，可以冻结涉嫌违法活动的银行业金融机构的账户；对涉嫌转移或者隐匿违法资金的，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，可以申请司法机关予以冻结。国务院银行业监督管理机构根据履行职责的需要，可以与银行业金融机构董事、高级管理人员进行监督管理谈话，要求银行业金融机构董事、高级管理人员就银行业金融机构的业务活动和风险管理的重大事项作出说明。银行业金融机构有违法经营、经营管理不善等情形，不予撤销将严重危害金融秩序、损害公众利益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权予以撤销。银行业金融机构已经或者可能发生信用危机，严重影响存款人和其他客户合法权益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构可以依法对该银行业金融机构实行接管或者促成机构重组，接管和机构重组依照有关法律和国务院的规定执行。银行业金融机构被接管、重组或者被撤销的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权要求该银行业金融机构的董事、高级管理人员和其他工作人员，按照国务院银行业监督管理机构的要求履行职责。在接管、机构重组或者撤销清算期间，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，对直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员，可以采取下列措施：（一）直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员出境将对国家利益造成重大损失的，通知出境管理机关依法阻止其出境；（二）申请司法机关禁止其转移、转让财产或者对其财产设定其他权利。银行业金融机构违反审慎经营规则的，国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构应当责令限期改正；逾期未改正的，或者其行为严重危及该银行业金融机构的稳健运行、损害存款人和其他客户合法权益的，经国务院银行业监督管理机构或者其省一级派出机构负责人批准，可以区别情形，采取下列措施：（一）责令暂停部分业务、停止批准开办新业务；（二）限制分配红利和其他收入；（三）限制资产转让；（四）责令控股股东转让股权或者限制有关股东的权利；（五）责令调整董事、高级管理人员或者限制其权利；（六）停止批准增设分支机构。银行业金融机构有违法经营、经营管理不善等情形，不予撤销将严重危害金融秩序、损害公众利益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权予以撤销。银行业金融机构已经或者可能发生信用危机，严重影响存款人和其他客户合法权益的，国务院银行业监督管理机构可以依法对该银行业金融机构实行接管或者促成机构重组，接管和机构重组依照有关法律和国务院的规定执行。银行业金融机构被接管、重组或者被撤销的，国务院银行业监督管理机构有权要求该银行业金融机构的董事、高级管理人员和其他工作人员，按照国务院银行业监督管理机构的要求履行职责。在接管、机构重组或者撤销清算期间，经国务院银行业监督管理机构负责人批准，对直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接责任人员，可以采取下列措施：（一）直接负责的董事、高级管理人员和其他直接 translations.baseline: 1949年后，清华大学改名为清华大学，校徽也相应调整至今。清华大学现行校徽为圆形，中心为五角星，中层为“自强不息，厚德载物”八字校训，最外层为“1911”和英文校名。1949年后，梁思成以清华古钟的钟体造型为原型，创作了新的校徽（或校铃），或“清华”二字以警钟的钟体造型为笔画，寓意深远。1998年，校徽也被认定为官方校徽，颜色与校徽一致。

translations.baseline: 截至2023年4月，有182个国家与中华人民共和国建立正式外交关系，而一中原则是中华人民共和国与中华民国建立外交关系的前提，建交公报中必须作出相应的承诺。而与中华人民共和国建交的国家中，有17个国家与台湾地区保持非官方往来。中华人民共和国政府认为，台湾问题是中国内政，不接受任何国家与台湾地区进行官方往来。

items.source_text: The analyser () is a mechanical generic computer designed by the British mathematician Charles Barbeche. From its first design in 1837 until his death in 1871, the machine was not really manufactured for a variety of reasons.

translations.baseline: 分析机（）是英国数学家查尔斯·巴贝奇设计的一种机械通用计算机。从1837年最初设计到1871年巴贝奇去世，这台机器因为各种原因一直没有真正制造出来。分析机的原理和现代计算机非常相似，包括存储程序、输入、输出、运算等。巴贝奇的分析机是世界上第一台计算机的雏形。

items.source_text: The crew of the Space Shuttle will vary according to mission. Only two crew members will be involved in each test flight, one commander and one pilot, two of whom will be qualified pilots, capable of flying orbital vehicles and landing. Various orbital missions, including experiments, cargo transport, off-board activities, will be carried out primarily by mission specialists, who will be trained prior to their departure. NASA arranges for load specialists to travel with the delivery mission at an early stage of the Space Shuttle Plan, most of which will be system specialists from the single-carrying company. Gregory Jarvis, who lost his life in the accident of STS-51-L, is the last carrier expert to follow the space shuttle, and since then all crew members, except the pilot, are mission specialists. The STS-51-C and STS-51-J missions are accompanied by one space engineer as a representative of the military, since the two missions are operated by the National Surveillance Agency of the United States.

items.source_text: The First World War put his development in crisis. When he was 42, military service disrupted his life. He was unable to work continuously and undisturbed, leaving behind many unfinished works and undeveloped “starts”. On one occasion, a superior officer asked him whether he was “the infamous Homberg”, and he said, “Report, sir, yes. items.source_text: International humanitarian law (IHL) is the law governing the conduct of armed conflict (the law of war). It is a branch of international law designed to limit the effects of armed conflict by protecting persons no longer taking part in hostilities and limiting and regulating the means and methods of warfare available to combatants. The creation of IHL stems from considerations of humanity and the reduction of human suffering. “IHL contains a set of rules established by treaties or custom to protect persons and objects affected or likely to be affected by armed conflict and to limit the use by belligerents of the means and means of warfare chosen.” It includes “the Geneva Conventions and Hague Conventions, as well as a number of other treaties, case law and customary international law.” It sets out the conduct of belligerents, neutrals and individuals involved in war, as well as their responsibilities towards each other and towards protected persons (usually non-combatants). It aims to maintain a balance between humanitarian considerations and military necessity, which makes war subject to legal regulation, thus limiting the devastating effects of war and reducing human suffering.

translations.baseline: 国际人道法（IHL）是规范武装冲突行为的法律（战争法）。它是国际法的一个分支，旨在限制武装冲突的影响，通过保护不再参与敌对行动的人，限制和规范战斗人员可选择的作战手段和方法。国际人道法的产生源于人道主义考虑和减少人类苦难的考虑。“国际人道法包含了一套由条约或习惯建立的规则，旨在保护受到或可能受到武装冲突影响的人和物，并限制交战方使用所选择的作战手段和方法。”它包括“日内瓦公约和海牙公约，以及一系列其他条约、判例法和习惯国际法”。它规定了交战方、中立方和参与战争的个人的行为，以及他们相互之间的责任和对受保护人员（通常是非战斗人员）的责任。其目的是在人道主义考虑和军事必要性之间保持平衡，从而使战争受到法律的规范，从而限制战争的毁灭性影响，减少人类苦难。

items.source_text: A mutation that causes phenylketonuria undermines the ability of the body to degrade phenylpropanate, leading to the accumulation of toxic intermediates in the body, leading to serious developmental retardation and epilepsy. Patients with phenylketone urea mutation need to follow a strict diet in order to avoid the ingestion of food containing phenylpropanate in order to maintain a normal and healthy life.

items.source_text: The market sales rate (Price-to-Sales Ratio, P/S or PSR) is also translated as a share price ratio, market value ratio, and is an indicator of the value of the stock. The market sales rate is based on the market value of the company, divided by the operating income of the preceding fiscal year (or quarter), or the equivalent value of the company’s share, divided by the operating income per share. It is also an important reference in the investment banking business.

items.source_text: In addition to repealing the Glass-Steagall Act, other measures introduced in the near future that could lead to a financial crisis include fair market accounting, Basel agreements, and adjustable interest rate mortgages. In 1948, under the influence of the United States occupation authorities, Japan’s financial sector also formed a decentralized business model, but the Bank of Japan owns shares.

translations.baseline: 除了废除格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案外，近期内推出的其他可能导致金融危机的措施还包括公平市场会计、巴塞爾協定和可调利率抵押贷款。1948年，在美国占领军的影响下，日本的金融业也形成了分散经营的模式，但日本银行拥有股份。日本的银行在1990年代以前，一直保持稳健的经营，但1990年代以后，日本的银行开始出现不良贷款，日本的经济也陷入长期的低迷。

items.source_text: Killer NIC is the global premiere network card dedicated to computer games, launched by Bigfoot Networks. With Max FPS technology, the web card helps process the network data independently and ensures that the CPU is not affected by network connections. Prior to this, nVIDIA already provided similar network processing functions in the nForce 500 chip group.

translations.baseline: Killer NIC是Bigfoot Networks公司推出的全球首款专门用于电子游戏的网络卡。它拥有Max FPS技术，网卡可独立处理网络数据，保证CPU不受网络连接影响。在此之前，nVIDIA已经在nForce 500芯片组中提供了类似的网络处理功能。Killer NIC的出现，使得游戏机和PC游戏机之间的界限越来越模糊。
translations.opd: Killer NIC是全球首款专为电脑游戏设计的网络卡，由Bigfoot Networks公司推出。借助Max FPS技术，该网卡能够独立处理网络数据，确保CPU不受网络连接的影响。在此之前，nVIDIA已经在nForce 500芯片组中提供了类似的网络处理功能。
translations.grpo: Killer NIC是Bigfoot Networks公司推出的全球首款专门用于电子游戏的网络卡。它拥有Max FPS技术，网卡可独立处理网络数据，保证CPU不受网络连接影响。在此之前，nVIDIA已经在nForce 500芯片组中提供了类似的网络处理功能。Killer NIC的驱动程序可以自动检测游戏，然后将网络数据的处理任务交给网卡，从而提高游戏的帧率。

items.source_text: HTML super-file sign language (English: HyperText Markup Language, or HTML) is a sign language for web page creation and other information designs that can be seen in web browsers. The XML extenuable sign language (eXtensible Markup Language, or XML), also known as extensible tag language, is a sign language. The sign refers to information symbols that computers understand, through which computers can process articles containing a variety of information, etc.

translations.baseline: HTML超文件標記語言（英語：HyperText Markup Language，簡稱HTML）是一種標記語言，用於網頁創建和可以在網頁瀏覽器中看到的其他信息設計。XML可擴展標記語言（英語：eXtensible Markup Language，簡稱XML），又稱可擴充標記語言，是一種標記語言。標記是指電腦能理解的信息符號，通過標記，電腦可以處理包含各種信息的文檔等。
translations.opd: HTML超文件标记语言（英语：HyperText Markup Language，简称HTML）是一种用于网页创建和其他可以在网页浏览器中看到的信息设计的标记语言。XML可扩展标记语言（英语：eXtensible Markup Language，简称XML），又称可扩展标签语言，是一种标记语言。标记是指计算机能够理解的信息符号，通过这些符号，计算机可以处理包含各种信息的文章等。
translations.grpo: 超文本标记语言（，英文：HyperText Markup Language，简称HTML）是一种用于网页创建和其他信息设计的标记语言，可以在网页浏览器中看到。可扩展标记语言（，英文：eXtensible Markup Language，简称XML），又稱可擴充標記語言，是一种标记语言。標記是指電腦可以理解的資訊符號，透過標記，電腦可以處理包含各種資訊的文檔等。

items.source_text: In June 2002, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China signed the Memorandum of Cooperation between the Ministry of Education and Microsoft Corporation, which jointly launched the Great Wall Programme to help raise the level of basic computer research and human resources in high schools in China, and to develop the quality of information science and technology subjects. As a practical implementation unit of the Long City Programme, the University has carried out systematic and targeted cooperation projects with a number of higher educational institutions in the country. Since then, the Great Wall Project has been successfully implemented. In October 2005, November 2008, October 2011 and April 2015, the Ministry of Education and Microsoft Corporation have signed a Memorandum of Cooperation, which has jointly launched the Long City Plan II, III, IV and V, which aims to help upgrade the quality of computer research in high schools in China.

translations.baseline: 2002年6月，中华人民共和国教育部与微软公司签署《教育部与微软公司合作备忘录》，共同启动“长城计划”，帮助提升中国中学计算机基础研究水平和人力资源，发展信息技术学科教学质量。作为“长城计划”的具体实施单位，联想集团与国内多所高校开展了系统性的合作项目，取得显著成效。2005年10月、2008年11月、2011年10月和2015年4月，教育部与微软公司又先后签署《合作备忘录》，共同启动“长城计划II、III、IV、V”，旨在帮助提升中国中学计算机研究水平。
translations.opd: 2002年6月，中华人民共和国教育部与微软公司签署了《教育部与微软公司合作备忘录》，共同启动了“长城计划”，旨在帮助提高中国高中计算机研究和人力资源水平，并发展信息技术学科的质量。作为“长城计划”的实际执行单位，该大学与国内多所高校开展了系统性和针对性的合作项目。自那时起，“长城计划”已成功实施。2005年10月、2008年11月、2011年10月和2015年4月，教育部与微软公司签署了《合作备忘录》，共同启动了“长城计划II、III、IV和V”，旨在帮助提升中国高中计算机研究的质量。

items.source_text: Covering the network is a network that is built on other networks. Covering nodes in the network connects through virtual or logical links. Each link corresponds to one or more paths in the underlying network. Covering the network is usually different from the underlying network. For example, many peer networks cover the network. The node in the peer network operates on the Internet and is organized into a virtual link system.

translations.baseline: 覆盖网络是在其他网络上建立起来的网络。覆盖网络中的节点通过虚拟或逻辑链路连接。每个链路对应于底层网络中的一个或多个路径。覆盖网络通常与底层网络不同。例如，许多对等网络覆盖了互联网。对等网络中的节点在互联网上运行，并组织成一个虚拟链路系统。

items.source_text: China's drawings are composed of national drawings, mainly with brushes, pens, or fingers, and with ink and national paint colours on paper. China's drawings can be divided according to content into flowerbirds, mountain water paintings, and drawings of characters; they can be divided into pens, drawings, paints, ink, white drawings, murals, interior drawings, etc. China's drawings can be divided into portraits and abstract drawings, depending on the level of the art.

translations.baseline: 中国画以毛笔、墨、国画颜料在纸、绢上作画，主要以线条和墨色的变化来表达对象。中国画按内容可分为花鸟画、山水画、人物画；按技法可分为工笔、写意、青绿、泼墨、白描、壁画、室内画等。中国画按艺术的抽象程度可分为具象画和抽象画。
translations.opd: 中国画由国画组成，主要使用毛笔、钢笔或手指，在纸上使用墨水和国画颜料。中国画可以根据内容分为花鸟画、山水画和人物画；可以根据形式分为钢笔画、素描、油画、水墨画、白描、壁画、室内画等。中国画可以根据艺术水平分为肖像画和抽象画。

items.source_text: Chloes is considered to be the first to issue pure gold and pure silver currency, and to standardize it for general circulation. Until then, Ludys had been in circulation with amber gold coins, a gold alloy extracted from natural river sands.

translations.baseline: 克洛伊索斯被认为是第一个发行纯金和纯银货币，并且为通用流通货币制定标准的人。在此之前，吕底亚人一直使用琥珀金（一种从天然河沙中提炼的金合金）作为流通货币。克洛伊索斯的货币是纯金和纯银，重量和纯度都经过了严格的控制。克洛伊索斯的货币在当时是世界通用货币，甚至在遥远的中国也发现了这种货币。

items.source_text: In terms of literature, the Taiwan Cultural Fund, which was founded in 1995, promoted exchanges between Taiwanese culture and the international community, mainly through exchanges and interviews at city festivals, as well as through the marketing of Gulf culture, which increased knowledge and communication between Taiwan and the international community. By October 8, 2011, China’s national passports had reached 124 countries worldwide free of visa.

items.source_text: The black market and foreign exchange began to depreciate rapidly as a result of the economic crisis and price increases in Zloty, Poland, the exchange rate of Zloty and the United States dollar imposed by the General Workers’ Party Government, the private sector began to exchange money through the black market, the black market economy began to emerge, and the people purchased scarce daily and consumer goods through the black market. In order to collect foreign exchange, the General Workers’ Party government opened a foreign exchange shop, called Peewex, which can only purchase goods using foreign exchange.

由于经济危机和物价上涨，波兰兹罗提开始快速贬值，工人党政府规定的兹罗提和美元的汇率，民间开始通过黑市兑换货币，黑市经济开始出现，人们通过黑市购买稀缺的日用品和消费品。为了收集外汇，工人党政府开设了外汇商店，称为皮韦克斯，只能用外汇购买商品。
translations.opd: 由于经济危机和波兰兹罗提的物价上涨，黑市和外汇开始迅速贬值，波兰兹罗提与美元的汇率由工人党政府规定，私营部门开始通过黑市兑换货币，黑市经济开始出现，人们通过黑市购买稀缺的日用品和消费品。为了收集外汇，工人党政府开设了一家外汇商店，名为Peewex，只能使用外汇购买商品。

items.source_text: The first sequenced protein was insulin, which was done by Frederik Sanger, who was awarded the 1958 Nobel Prize for Chemistry. The first dissected protein structure consisted of the structure of haemoglobin and mystroglobin, using X-ray crystallization; the work was done by Max Peruts and John Kendru, respectively, in 1958, and as a result received the 1962 Nobel Prize for Chemistry. By 2017, the protein database (PDB) had contained the coordinates of three-dimensional structures of proteins and their associated compounds at close to 126,000 atomic-level resolutions.

translations.baseline: 第一个被测序的蛋白质是胰岛素，这项工作由弗雷德里克·桑格完成，他因此获得了1958年的诺贝尔化学奖。第一个解析出的蛋白质结构是血红蛋白和肌红蛋白的结构，使用X射线晶体学的方法；这项工作分别由马克斯·佩鲁茨和约翰·肯德鲁在1958年完成，因此他们获得了1962年的诺贝尔化学奖。到2017年，蛋白质数据库（PDB）中包含了近12.6万个蛋白质及其相关化合物的三维结构的坐标，分辨率接近原子级。

The difference processor will then compare the values in the current pixel channel with the first or the previous or upper (EX: Top Left) pixel point, with the differentials.

translations.baseline: 每次对图像中某一行（EX：Top Left）的数据进行滤波（）处理，每个像素点（EX：RGB）都会被不同通道（EX：RGB）的滤波器进行测量，再由差分处理器进行重新计算。差分处理器会将当前像素通道中的数值与第一个或者前一个或者上一个（EX：Top Left）像素点的数值进行比较，得出差值。

translations.baseline: 國際關係學雖然根植於第一次世界大戰後期，但這並不意味著前人從未思考過國際關係，正如有人指出：「國際政治思想與人類歷史一樣悠久。」但國際關係的觀念並非人人皆知，主要的原因是相關的論述不多：當我們仔細檢視政治思想的經典時，發現關於國際關係的論述很少。
translations.opd: 国际关系虽然根植于第一次世界大战之后，但这并不意味着以前从未想过国际关系，正如有人指出，“国际政治思想与世界第一个独立政治共同体一样古老。”但国际关系的概念对我们来说并不陌生，主要是因为它们很少：当我们仔细研究政治思想的经典时，我们会发现很少有谈论国际关系的内容。

items.source_text: In the first place, Locke says that every person “owns” himself, so that every person is in a natural state free and equal. Thus, everyone must also own the product of his labor, denying it is equivalent to treating him as a slave. So everyone has the right to mix his own labor with natural resources: an apple that grows on a tree has no use to everyone, and it can only be eaten when someone takes it, and the apple becomes the property of the person who takes it. Locke raises another argument at the same time that we must allow the apple to be taken as private property, or that he must be the owner of the apple, no matter how rich it is in the world, and that all human beings must die hungry. A person must also be allowed to eat. He has the right to eat the fruits that he has worked on it.

translations.baseline: 第一個，洛克說每個人「擁有」自己，所以每個人在自然狀態下都是自由和平等的。因此，每個人也必須擁有他所勞動的產物，否認這一點就等於把他當成奴隸看待。所以每個人有權把他的勞動與自然資源混合：一個長在樹上的蘋果對所有人來說沒有用處，只有當有人摘下它時，蘋果才成為摘下它的人的財產。洛克同時提出另一個論點，我們必須允許蘋果成為私有財產，否則不管世界裡有再多蘋果，他人都必須是蘋果的主人，而所有的人類都必須餓死。一個人必須也允許他吃蘋果。他有權吃他所勞動的蘋果。
translations.opd: 首先，洛克说每个人“拥有”自己，因此每个人处于自然状态中都是自由和平等的。因此，每个人也必须拥有自己劳动的产品，否认这一点就相当于将他视为奴隶。所以，每个人都有权将自己的劳动与自然资源混合：一棵树上生长的苹果对每个人都没有用处，只有当有人摘下它时才能被吃掉，苹果也就成了摘下它的人的财产。洛克同时提出了另一个论点，即我们必须允许苹果成为私有财产，否则无论世界多么富有，他都必须是苹果的主人，所有人类都必须饿死。一个人也必须被允许吃掉。他有权吃掉他所劳动的果实。

items.source_text: On 15 April 1998, just two days before the 23rd anniversary of the Khmer Rouge’s occupation of Phnom Penh, the Voice of America reported that the Khmer Rouge had agreed to hand over Polbut to an international trial. Polbutt was a loyal listener to the Voice of America. According to Polbut’s wife, Spobbt, died in bed the same evening while he was waiting to be transferred to another location. Tamouk claimed that Polbut died of heart failure; because of the color of his body’s nails, there were suspicions that he had died of poisoning suicide or murder.

items.source_text: Early browsers do not support PNG images; JPEG and GIF are mainstream image formats. Because of the GIF's colour depth limitations, the colour transition images on the web pages use JPEG. In any case, JPEG compression can lead to a slight blurring of the image. The PNG can be as accurate as possible at the appropriate colour depth while keeping the image file low. The PNG has gradually become a better choice for small gradient images, and many browsers are already well supported by PNG.

translations.baseline: 早期的浏览器不支持PNG图像；JPEG和GIF是主流的图像格式。由于GIF的颜色深度限制，网页上的色彩过渡图像使用JPEG。无论如何，JPEG压缩会导致图像轻微模糊。PNG可以在适当的颜色深度下尽可能准确，同时保持图像文件低。PNG逐渐成为小渐变图像更好的选择，而且许多浏览器已经很好地支持PNG。

items.source_text: Information processing Computers were invented in the 1940s, together with mathematical informatics, which made it possible for the brain to understand as an information processing system. This concept forms the basis of the theory of control, which has given rise to what we now call a field of computational neuroscience. The first attempts at control theory seemed a little rough, when the essence of the brain was seen as a hidden computer. For example, John von Neumann’s 1958 book.

In the course of the year, more than 2,000 people gathered to take over the North for the purpose of helping King Siam and his daughter to marry him.

translations.baseline: 明洪武三十一年（1398年），广东海丰人王三保在南海居住30年期间，收留的1000多南海人，皆以王三保为名。明永乐元年（1403年），王三保之子王五保（又名王五福）聚集2000多人，以帮助王三保和其女成亲为名，攻占北山。明永乐二年（1404年），明军攻下北山，王五保被斩首，其部下被流放海南。
translations.opd: 在洪武三十年（1397年），居住在广东海面的南海一带的上千人，都以暹罗国王萨姆·富兹伊的名义生活。在这一年中，有两千多人聚集起来，准备北上，目的是帮助暹罗国王和他的女儿结婚。
translations.grpo: 明洪武三十一年（1398年），广东海丰人王三保在南海居住30年期间，聚集千余人，自称“大明国王三保”，在南海县西樵山一带活动。明太祖驾崩后，王三保于当年正月，纠集2000余人，攻占南海县，以助明惠宗（建文帝）和其女儿和亲为名，欲据南海自立。明廷派都指挥使张信率兵讨伐，王三保兵败被杀，余党被剿灭。

items.source_text: FAO responded to the food crisis in December 2007 by implementing a plan to respond to soaring food prices to help small producers increase their production and incomes. This plan is also a contribution of FAO to the comprehensive framework for action developed by the United Nations High-level Task Force on the Global Food Crisis, established in April 2008. FAO has implemented projects in 25 countries to carry out inter-agency missions in nearly 60 countries. Through global food and agriculture — {zh-hans: information; zh-hant: information;}-and early warning systems to improve monitoring, provide policy advice to countries while supporting their efforts to increase food production and encourage investment in agriculture. The plan also works closely with the European Union. For example, in Haiti, a $10 million high-quality seed distribution and breeding project has been implemented; the project has significantly increased food production, reduced food prices and increased farmers ' incomes.

translations.baseline: 2007年12月，粮农组织对粮食危机作出反应，实施了应对食品价格飙升的计划，以帮助小生产者增加产量和收入。该计划也是粮农组织对联合国高级别任务小组制定的全球粮食危机综合行动计划的贡献，该小组于2008年4月成立。粮农组织在25个国家实施了项目，在近60个国家开展了联合机构任务。通过全球粮食和农业——{zh-hans:信息; zh-hant:資訊;}-和早期预警系统，改进监测，为各国提供政策建议，同时支持其增加粮食产量的努力，并鼓励对农业的投资。该计划还与欧盟密切合作。例如，在海地，实施了一个1000万美元的高质量种子分发和育种项目；该项目显著增加了粮食产量，降低了食品价格，增加了农民的收入。

translations.baseline:
估值
估值是首次公开募股过程中的重要环节。估值过高或过低都会给承销商带来风险。估值过高会导致承销商的佣金收入减少，估值过低则会导致承销商承担过多的股票价格下跌的风险。因此，估值是承销商在首次公开募股过程中需要考虑的首要问题。估值过高或过低都会给承销商带来风险。估值过高会导致承销商的佣金收入减少，估值过低则会导致承销商承担过多的股票价格下跌的风险。因此，估值是承销商在首次公开募股过程中需要考虑的首要问题。
translations.opd: 还应考虑高估带来的风险。如果一只股票在公开发布时的价格超过了市场当时能够承受的水平，担保人将难以履行其出售股票的承诺。
translations.grpo:
估值過高
過度估值的股票，其股價可能在公開招股時，已經高於市場可承受的水平。如果股票的估值過高，承銷商將會發現難以履行其承銷股票的承諾。因此，承銷商會在公開招股時，將股票的估值調低，以減低股票估值過高的風險。

items.source_text: W-CDMA is a third generation mobile phone technology, which also uses CDMA reuse technology and is similar to the standard of Qualcomm. But W-CDMA is not just a standard for reuse. It is a complete set of norms that define how mobile phones communicate with base stations, how signals are modulated, how data frames are constructed, etc. W-CDMA can use non-combined or paired bands, although all current W-CMMA devices (e.g. FOMA and UMTS) use two 5 MHz bands, one for up-line and one for downline. For more information, please refer to the expanded frequency.

translations.baseline: W-CDMA是第三代移动电话技术，它也使用CDMA复用技术，和Qualcomm的标准很相似。但是W-CDMA不只是一个复用标准。它是一套完整的规范，定义了手机如何和基站通信，信号如何调制，数据帧如何构建等。W-CDMA可以使用非成对或成对的频段，尽管所有当前的W-CDMA设备（例如FOMA和UMTS）都使用两个5 MHz的成对频段，一个用于上行，一个用于下行。更多信息请参见扩频。

items.source_text: However, the new ideas put forward by Deng Xiaoping were quickly questioned by Maoist ideological and political-liberal supporters, and the policy of reform and opening up also raised many social problems. In 1986, Chinese society unleashed many student movements because of many social factors, and in early the following year caused the Central Communist Party (CPC) Secretary-General, Huyo State, to resign from his post because he was critical of the lack of effective liberalization of the intellectual class. On April 15, 1989, Hoyo State passed away, giving rise to student and crowd memorials, leading to massive student demonstrations.

items.source_text: Most proteins naturally fold into a specific three-dimensional structure, known as this particular structure. While most proteins can fold themselves through the nature of their own amino acid sequences, there are still many proteins that need the help of a molecular partner to do the right folding. Under conditions such as high temperatures or extreme pH, proteins lose their natural structure and activity, which is called variability. Biochemists often use the following four dimensions to express the protein structure: the linear amino acid sequence that makes up the protein multipolyte chain. A protein secondary structure is a polyamide. A stable structure that relies on hydrogen keys between different amino acids = O and N-Hquite, mainly alpha spirals and beta folds. Because the secondary structure is local, many regions of different secondary structures can be found in the same protein molecules.

translations.baseline: 大多数蛋白质天然地折叠成特定的三维结构，称为这种特定的构象。虽然大多数蛋白质可以通过自身氨基酸序列的性质而自行折叠，但仍有许多蛋白质需要分子伴侣的帮助才能正确折叠。在高温或极端pH等条件下，蛋白质会失去其天然结构和活性，这种现象称为变性。生物化学家经常使用以下四个维度来表达蛋白质结构：组成蛋白质多肽链的线性氨基酸序列。蛋白质二级结构是多肽链中依靠不同氨基酸残基之间氢键而稳定下来的结构，主要为α螺旋和β折叠。因为二级结构是局部的，所以在同一个蛋白质分子中可以发现许多不同二级结构的区域。三级结构是蛋白质分子中所有原子的空间位置。四级结构是多条多肽链组成的蛋白质分子中，各条多肽链的相对位置。

items.source_text: Lupinen, a Taiwanese political figure in the United States, is currently the United States Ambassador for Management and Reform at the United Nations. He was Vice-Minister of Labour in the United States from 2014 to 2017. He was Secretary-General of the White House Cabinet of the US President Barack Obama Administration from 2009 to 2013. Lupinin graduated from Princeton University (now the School of Public and International Affairs) and studied further at Harvard Law School.

translations.baseline: 盧培玉（），台灣裔美國政治人物，目前為美國駐聯合國管理與改革大使。曾任2014年至2017年美國勞工部副部長。曾任2009年至2013年美國總統奧巴馬政府白宮内阁的勞工部部長。盧培玉畢業於普林斯頓大學（現為公共與國際事務學院），並在哈佛大學法學院深造。

items.source_text: The word "simple" is the name used in the Chinese People's Republic of China's First CREDIT List (the official name of the People's Republic of China calls it "simple" and refers to the Simplified Words List). Since Chinese software is used mainly in mainland China, the word "simple" here is in fact equivalent to "GB2312" or "GB18030" and means that the Chinese version of "simple Chinese" in most of the software, especially the translation of IT terms, is not the same as the English translation abroad.

items.source_text: On March 24, 2001, Apple launched Mac OS X v10. The early version was slow and incomplete, with only a small number of applications from independent developers. Many commentators considered it not a mature popular product, but not a potential development project. Apple began to rewrite the Mac operating system in 1996. The introduction of Mac OS X 10.0 was a remarkable achievement for industry who looked forward to many years.

items.source_text: At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Dynasty Government signed the Nibchu Treaty with the Government of the Tsar of Russia, which China called an equality treaty, and Russia, which included Soviet times, called an inequality treaty (which Russians thought had taken back the land that had been taken over by the Chinese). Russia engaged in equal diplomacy in the middle of the Qing Dynasty as the only Qing Dynasty “with the state.” The view was expressed that this treaty symbolized the beginning of China’s modern-day diplomacy.

items.source_text: In 1994, the renminbi began a reform of the exchange-rate system. There are three main elements: a convergence of exchange rates, with a single, managed floating exchange-rate system based on market supply and demand. The renminbi’s exchange rate against the United States dollar was reduced from 5.7 to 8.7 and remained at about 8.3 for the following 10 years. The foreign exchange retention and surrender system was abolished and a mandatory remittance system was introduced.

translations.baseline: 1994年，人民币开始进行汇率制度的改革。改革的主要内容有三项：汇率并轨，实行单一的、有管理的浮动汇率制度，以市场供求为基础。人民币对美元的汇率由5.7：1调整为8.7：1，并在随后的10年中一直保持在约8.3左右。取消外汇留成和交售制度，实行强制结售汇制度。取消外汇指定银行的外汇买卖业务，由外汇交易中心统一经营。
translations.opd: 1994年，人民币开始进行汇率制度的改革。主要有三个要素：汇率的统一，实行单一的、以市场供求为基础的、有管理的浮动汇率制度。人民币对美元的汇率从5.7下调至8.7，并在接下来的十年中保持在约8.3的水平。取消了外汇保留和交回制度，并引入了强制结汇制度。
translations.grpo: 1994年，人民币开始进行汇率制度改革。改革的三大要素是：汇率并轨，实行单一的、有管理的浮动汇率制度，以市场供求为基础。人民币兑美元汇率由5.7比1调低到8.7比1，并在随后的10年中一直维持在约8.3左右。取消外汇留成和交售制度，实行强制结售汇制度。取消外汇指定银行的外汇买卖差价，实行统一的银行间外汇市场交易价格。

items.source_text: In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Outline for the Organization of the Municipal Administration of the Tianjin Law Renting Community, the Board of Directors of the Tianjin Law Community is elected by taxpayers in the Tianjin legal community. The French Consul in Tianjin has de facto executive authority in the Tianjin legal community. The consul is the legal general director, or the chairman of the Finance, Health and Public Works Commission, and is also responsible for convening and chairing the annual general assembly of electors on the electoral board. In addition, the General Directorate of the Tianjin Law Renting Community elects some or most of the members of the board of directors of the Tianjin Law Renting Community.

items.source_text: On 1 July 1955, China’s central government issued a directive on anti-revolutionary elements hidden behind battles. In China’s mainland provinces, cities, autonomous regions, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) and central first-level parties, government and crowds began a political campaign “to clear up all hidden anti-revolutionaries.” On 25 August, China’s central government issued a directive on anti-revolutionary elements hidden in the past, setting Mao Zedong’s rate of repression among the various groups at 5%.

items.source_text: In May 1911, the Qing Government announced the “State policy on the railway main line” to nationalize the construction of the railway and to sell it to banks in such countries as the United Kingdom, France, the United States, Germany, etc. Since 17 June, the Sichuan-based Gay Roads Campaign has been set up, and the people involved have officially launched a campaign to strike the city under the leadership of Wu Okang, Wang Tianjie and others. The campaign soon swept over the entire province of Sichuan. On 7 September, the Governor of Sichuan, Zalfon, then the main leader of the Mobuntain Road Campaign, Zhang Luang, and ordered the shooting of petitioners in Chengdu, which resulted in the death of more than 30 people.

translations.baseline: 1911年5月，清政府宣布“铁路干线国有政策”，将川汉铁路的修建权和经营权卖给英、法、美、德等国的银行，史称“保路运动”。自6月17日起，四川保路同志会成立，参与人员在吴玉章、王天杰等人的领导下，正式发动保路运动，罢市、罢课、罢工。运动很快席卷整个四川全省。9月7日，四川总督赵尔丰下令在成都枪杀请愿群众，史称“成都血案”，造成30余人死亡。

items.source_text: In his book Banks of the Poor: Microcredit and the Fight against the World's Poverty () Mohamed Yunus shows the vision behind the business model of the Greivan Bank: “When you put the world in the palm of hand and look at it from the sky, you become arrogant, and you don't realize that it's a vicious circle of poverty when you look far away. The Greiv Bank is built on the deep love and compassion of a person for a socially abandoned group. I understand the problems they face from the point of view of the poor. We see that Yunus, together with banks and communities, has taken active action to help people like Sufiya to obtain credit and to make the most effective use of the money.

translations.baseline: 在《穷人的银行家：微信贷与世界贫困的斗争》（）一书中，穆罕默德·尤努斯展示了格莱珉银行商业模式背后的愿景：“当你把世界握在掌心，从天空中俯视它，你会变得傲慢，当你从远处看时，你不会意识到贫困是一个恶性循环。格莱珉银行建立在一个人对社会被遗弃的群体的深深的爱和同情。我从穷人的角度理解他们所面临的问题。我们看到，尤努斯与银行和社区一起，采取了积极行动，帮助像苏菲亚这样的人获得信贷，并使资金得到最有效的利用。

items.source_text: The day after the signing of the agreement, the French-British military delegation urgently requested a meeting with the Soviet military negotiator, Kremente Voroschlov. items.source_text: The 2004 Pitcairn Island rape trial is a good example of how Britain can provide legal aid to the Overseas Territories in special cases that cannot be handled independently. The Overseas Territories ' relationship with the British Foreign and Commonwealth Office is responsible for the management of the interests of all British Overseas Territories (except the British base areas). The Overseas Territories Department is headed by the Secretary of State of the Foreign Office for Overseas Territories, and the current Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State is Chris Bryant. The only exception is that the British base area falls under the jurisdiction of the Department of Defense.

items.source_text: Selectable data streams do not appear in Windows resource managers, nor do they count the size of the files shown when viewing file properties. If files are copied to the FAT format disk, attached to e-mail, uploaded to the website, or moved to any other location that does not support optional streams, only the main data streams will be retained and all other optional streams will be discarded, so it is likely that there will be an accident using an optional stream to save important data. Microsoft provides a tool called Streams, which users can use to view optional streams in the files. Starting with Windows Powershell version 3.0, the following cmdlet supports the operation of optional data streams: Add-Content, Clear-Conent, Get-Item, Out-String, Remove-Item, and Set-Item.

items.source_text: In a state of anarchy, sovereign states are the most important actors in the international system. Realists view the state as the basic unit of analysis of international relations, with the international community's fundamental characteristics as being centred on sovereign states, with the interaction among sovereign states as its main element. The central actor in international relations — sovereign states — is a single, rational actor. In the eyes of realists, while there is a pluralistic political power within the state, the fundamental interest of the state in the international arena is power and security. In the eyes of realists, the history and reality of international relations are no more than those of super-persons, super-classes, super-social groups.

translations.baseline: 在无政府状态下，主权国家是国际体系中最重要的行为体。现实主义者将国家视为国际关系的基本分析单位，国际社会的基本特征是主权国家为中心，主权国家之间的互动是其主要要素。国际关系中的中心行为体——主权国家，是一个单一的、理性的行为体。在现实主义者的看来，虽然国家内部存在多元的政治权力，但国家在国际舞台上的根本利益是权力和安全。在现实主义者看来，国际关系的历史和现实，无非是超个人、超阶级、超社会集团的权力斗争。

translations.opd: 考古学对仙人洞和陶罐环的研究表明，中国早在18,000多年前就制作了陶器。陶罐表明中国是第一个进入新石器时代国家。仙人洞和陶罐环还发现了半驯化的野生稻，这是中国最早稻米种植的证据。
translations.grpo:
考古學成果
河姆渡文化與良渚文化出土的陶器表明，中國早在18000多年前就已經會製造陶器。陶器的出現表明中國是最早進入新石器時代的國家。河姆渡文化與良渚文化還出土了半培植的人工栽培稻，這是中國也是世界上最早培植水稻的證據。

items.source_text: On March 24, 1959, the central government of the People’s Republic of China established the West, South and Central Sha Islands Office (known as the West, South and Central Sha Islands Office, the West and South Sassah Office or the West Sassa Islands Office) to exercise its authority and control over the West, South and Central Sha Islands and the surrounding maritime areas.

translations.baseline: 1959年3月24日，中华人民共和国中央政府设立西沙、南沙、中沙群岛办事处（简称西沙、南沙、中沙群岛办事处、西沙群岛办事处或西沙群岛南海办事处），行使对西沙群岛、南沙群岛和中沙群岛及其附近海域的主权和管辖权。1988年4月，西沙、南沙、中沙群岛办事处升格为地级三沙市，由海南省代管。

items.source_text: Australia’s continent, which was inhabited by humans in ancient times, was only discovered in the 17th century’s era of great seafaring, and became the site of British colonization and exile of prisoners. But during the end of the 18th century, major battles, such as the Great War and the Korean War, became a hot spot for immigration and investment. Because of their relatively isolated geographical location, Australia has not been affected by international wars since colonization, and there have been few wars and conflicts within it, but only the northern city of Darwin was affected by the war of the Second World War. But during the two wars of the world and the Korean War, major battles, such as the Great War, have taken place in Europe, the Korean Peninsula, and other countries and organizations that have supported the United Kingdom, the United Nations, etc.

translations.baseline: 澳洲大陸在古代就有原住民居住，但在17世紀的大航海時代才被發現，成為英國殖民地和流放罪犯的場所。但到了18世紀末，澳洲成為移民和投資的熱點。由於其相對孤立的地理位置，自從殖民以來澳洲並未受到國際戰爭的影響，內部也少有戰爭和衝突，僅有北部城市達爾文在第二次世界大戰時受到戰火波及。但在兩次世界大戰和朝鮮戰爭期間，歐洲、韓半島等地發生了大規模戰爭，澳洲也參與了其中，並有部分國家和組織如英國、聯合國等支持澳洲。
translations.opd: 澳大利亚大陆在古代曾由人类居住，直到17世纪的大航海时代才被发现，并成为英国殖民地和流放囚犯的地方。但在18世纪末，如第一次世界大战和朝鲜战争等重大战役成为移民和投资的热点。由于其相对孤立的地理位置，自殖民以来澳大利亚未受国际战争影响，内部也鲜有战争和冲突，仅北部城市达尔文受第二次世界大战影响。但在两次世界大战和朝鲜战争期间，如第一次世界大战等重大战役发生在欧洲、朝鲜半岛及其他支持英国、联合国等国家和地区。
translations.grpo: 澳洲大陸在古代就有原住民居住，但在17世紀的大航海時代才被發現，並成為英國殖民地和流放囚犯的場所。但到了18世紀末，澳洲成為移民和投資的熱點。由於其相對孤立的地理位置，自從殖民以來澳洲並未受到國際戰爭的影響，內部也少有戰爭和衝突，僅有北部城市達爾文在第二次世界大戰時受到戰火波及。但在兩次世界大戰和朝鮮戰爭期間，歐洲、韓半島等地發生了大規模戰爭，澳洲也參與了其中，並有許多國家和組織支持英國、聯合國等。在第二次世界大戰期間，澳洲曾被日本入侵，但最終在盟軍的幫助下擊退了日本。

items.source_text: An asset mortgage is usually a bond or instrument issued by a bank, a credit card company’s loan agreement, or an account receivable as the basis for the guarantee. ABS can be divided into two categories, namely credit card loans, student loans, car loans, equipment leases, consumer loans, mortgage loans for housing assets, and a securitized product for assets subject to bank loans.

translations.baseline: 资产抵押证券（Asset-backed securities，ABS）是将缺乏流动性但能够产生可预见的稳定现金流的资产作为基础资产，通过结构性重组，将其转化为可以在金融市场上出售和流通的证券。资产抵押证券通常是以银行、信用卡公司发放的贷款协议、应收账款等作为基础资产。ABS可以分为两类，一类是消费信贷，包括信用卡贷款、学生贷款、汽车贷款、设备租赁、消费贷款等；一类是住房资产抵押贷款，是银行发放的贷款的资产证券化产品。
translations.opd: 资产抵押通常是由银行、信用卡公司发放的债券或票据，或应收账款作为担保的基础。ABS可以分为两类，即信用卡贷款、学生贷款、汽车贷款、设备租赁、消费贷款、住房资产抵押贷款，以及一种针对银行贷款的资产证券化产品。
translations.grpo: 资产抵押证券（Asset-backed securities，ABS）是将缺乏流动性但能够产生可预见的稳定现金流的资产作为基础资产，通过结构性重组，将其转化为可以在金融市场上出售和流通的证券。资产抵押证券通常是以银行、信用卡公司发放的贷款协议、应收账款等作为担保基础发行的债券或票据。ABS可以分为两类，一类是消费信贷，包括信用卡贷款、学生贷款、汽车贷款、设备租赁、消费贷款等；一类是资产抵押贷款，包括住房资产抵押贷款。资产抵押证券是银行贷款的资产证券化产品。

items.source_text: There are a number of names for the outcasts. As Buddhists were born in India in the “Shamen Sith,” Buddhists also call themselves Shamun (the family), because they seek justice in their own homes (the family); as a member of the Sangha community, they call monks, monks (the family); as a member of the Sangha community, they call themselves monks, monks (the family). They are generally called the Masters (the Sanskrit: dharma-bhaka, Bali: dhamma-kathika); as a monk of the sort who speaks the law, and as a post-monster), elders or members of the House (the Sanskrit: Thera), elders or saints (the Sanskrit: ārya, the Sanctuary), Grand-Dah (the Sansk: bhadanta), which is a common term for all Buddhist denominations, especially in the south.

translations.baseline:
出家人的稱謂
出家人有許多稱謂。由於佛教徒出家於“沙門”（Sramana），佛教徒也稱自己為沙門（Sramana，沙門），因為他們在家裡尋求正法（Dharma）；作為僧團的成員，他們稱自己為僧（Sangha，僧團）。一般稱為大德（Sanskrit: dharma-bhākā, Pali: dhamma-kathika）；作為講經說法的僧侶，和出家後的長者或比丘（Sanskrit: Thera），尊者或聖者（Sanskrit: ārya，聖者），大德（Sanskrit: bhadanta），是所有佛教宗派的通用稱謂，尤其在南傳佛教中。
translations.opd: 出家人有多种名称。由于佛教徒诞生于印度的“沙门”（僧侣）中，佛教徒也称自己为沙门（僧侣），因为他们寻求在家（家庭）中的正义；作为僧团的一员，他们称僧侣为僧侣（僧侣）。作为僧团的一员，他们称僧侣为僧侣（僧侣）。他们通常被称为大师（梵语：dharma-bhākā，巴利语：dhamma-kathika）；作为讲法的僧侣，以及作为后世的僧侣），长老或家庭成员（梵语：Thera），长老或圣人（梵语：ārya，圣人），大德（梵语：bhadanta），这是所有佛教教派的通用术语，尤其是在南传佛教中。

items.source_text: In the autumn of 1594, after entering a treaty with Transylvania and Moldavia, Mikhail fought against the Ottoman Empire and took part in the 13-year war waged by the Holy Roman Empire. The following year, Mikhail signed a treaty with Transylvania recognizing his sovereignty, and then, with the assistance of Transylvania, Mihai repeatedly defeated the Ottoman Army and seized large areas along the Danube, including Bucharest.

translations.baseline: 1594年秋天，米哈伊在与特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔多瓦签订条约后，开始与奥斯曼帝国作战，并参与了神圣罗马帝国进行的十三年战争。次年，米哈伊与特兰西瓦尼亚签订条约，承认其宗主权，随后在特兰西瓦尼亚的帮助下，米哈伊多次击败奥斯曼军队，并夺取了多瑙河沿岸大片地区，包括布加勒斯特。

In 1984, Michael Friedman and Robert Tayan invented the Fai Poonachs, and the time required for the Prim algorithm to operate was increased in theory. Joseph Cruskal published his algorithm in 1956, mentioning in his paper a variant of the Prim algorithm, which was already mentioned in his paper in the 1920s.

items.source_text: In ancient Rome, there is a distinction between civil law and civil law. Since their general religious laws are not suitable for foreigners, the Romans take away the law from religion and call it “ten thousand civil law.” Civil law is not international law, but only Roman private law involving foreigners. But, at least from Cicero, civil law is understood as a principle of justice agreed upon by all countries with which Rome interacts, as distinct from natural law () based on natural justice.

translations.baseline: 在古代罗马，有公法和私法之分。由于他们的普遍宗教法不适用于外国人，罗马人从宗教中拿走法律并称其为“万民法”。万民法不是国际法，而是只涉及外国人与罗马人之间的罗马私法。但是，至少从西塞罗开始，万民法被理解为所有与罗马互动的国家之间达成的正义原则，与基于自然正义的自然法（）相对。

items.source_text: The Treaty of Scheffer was signed by the Allied Powers and the Ottoman Empire on August 10th, 1920 in Thérèseville, France. There is a clause in the Treaty concerning Armenia. All the signatories to the Treaty recognize Armenia as a free and independent State. The territory of the Democratic Republic of Armenia, as set out in the Treaty, represents an incentive for Armenia to fight the Ottoman Empire during the battle in the Caucasus.

items.source_text: In the 1860s, the French founded China’s first museum in Shanghai to display specimens of flora and fauna in the Yangtze basin. There are now more than 100 museums in the city. items.source_text: Security. Eve, the eave listener, obtained Alice's public key and Bob's encrypted message, but she could not get Alice's key directly. To get it, the simplest way is to decompose it, so that she can get the rest of the equation and decipher it and export n (breakdown). To date, no one has found a multiple time algorithm to decipher a large whole factor, and no one can prove that it does not exist (see factor breakdown).

items.source_text: Computational geometry is a branch of computer science that emerged in the late 1970s, primarily focusing on the study of algorithms for solving geometric problems. Since the first electronic computer was introduced in 1946, a major milestone in computer applications has been the invention of the world's first graphic display in 1962 by MIT. Since then, computers can directly input and output graphics through graphic displays, and can move graphics on the display through a token while directly modifying graphics. Before that, engineers have been expressing digital engineering graphics through a thick layer of paper. 1962 is considered the year in which CAD began to develop in the United States and Europe. The first application areas are automotive, aircraft and shipbuilding.

items.source_text: Network access (connection) layers The network access (connection) layer is not actually part of the Internet protocol group, but it is a way for data packages to be transferred from the network layer of one device to the network layer of another. This process can be controlled in the software-driven process of a network card, either in a receptor or in a dedicated chip. This will complete some of the data link functions such as adding a headline, actually sending through the physical medium. At the other end, the link layer will complete the data frame receipt, remove the headline, and transmit the received package to the network layer. However, it is not often as simple as this. It may be a virtual proprietary network (VPN) or a tunnel, where the package from the network layer is sent to the other (or the same) and not to the physical interface. VPN and access are usually pre-built, and they have special features that are not directly sent to the physical interface (e.g., it can encode the data through it).

translations.baseline:
网络访问（连接）层
网络访问（连接）层并不是互联网协议组的一部分，但它是一个数据包从一个设备的网络层传输到另一个设备的网络层的方式。这个过程可以在网络卡的软件驱动程序中控制，也可以在接收器或专用芯片中控制。这将完成一些数据链路层的功能，如添加一个帧头，实际通过物理介质发送。在另一端，链路层将完成数据帧接收，去除帧头，将接收到的包传递到网络层。然而，这并不总是这么简单。它可能是一个虚拟专用网络（VPN）或隧道，其中从网络层发送的包被发送到另一个（或相同的）网络，而不是物理接口。VPN和访问通常预设，它们具有特殊功能，不会直接发送到物理接口（例如，它可以对数据进行编码）。

网络访问（连接）层
网络访问（连接）层实际上并不是互联网协议组的一部分，但它是一种数据包从一个设备的网络层传输到另一个设备的网络层的方式。这个过程可以在网络卡的软件驱动过程中进行控制，要么在接收器中，要么在专用芯片中。这将完成一些数据链路功能，如添加标题，实际通过物理介质发送。在另一端，链路层将完成数据帧接收，移除标题，并将接收到的包传递到网络层。然而，这并不总是如此简单。它可能是虚拟专用网络（VPN）或隧道，其中来自网络层的包被发送到另一个（或相同的）设备，而不是物理接口。VPN和访问通常预先构建，它们具有特殊功能，不会直接发送到物理接口（例如，它可以对数据进行编码）。

网络访问（连接）层并不是互联网协议组的一部分，但它是一个数据包从一个设备的网络层传输到另一个设备的网络层的方式。这个过程可以在网络卡的软件驱动程序中控制，也可以在接收器或专用芯片中控制。这将完成一些数据链路层的功能，如添加一个帧头，实际通过物理介质发送。在另一端，链路层将完成数据帧接收，去除帧头，将接收到的包传递到网络层。然而，这并不总是这么简单。它可能是虚拟专用网络（VPN）或隧道，从网络层发送的包被发送到另一个（或相同的）网络接口，而不是物理接口。VPN和访问通常预设，它们具有特殊功能，不会直接发送到物理接口（例如，它可以对数据进行编码）。

items.source_text: In Shenzhen, there have been serious cases of corruption in which senior officials have used their position to facilitate large-scale enrichment, and some of the officials responsible for the crime were in high-ranking positions in the Government. In December 2002, Zhao Yu, former Shenzhen Customs Director, was sentenced to life imprisonment by the mid-level court of Shenzhen City for bribes of 9 million yuan; in November 2003, the former Deputy Mayor of Shenzhen was sentenced to 20 years ' imprisonment by the mid-level court of Guangzhou for bribery and abuse of authority; in June 2005, the former Director of Public Security of Lo Lake Region, An Xiang, was sentenced to 15 years ' imprisonment by the mid-level court of Shenzhen Shenzhen for bribery; and in May 2011, the mid-level court of Zhengzhou sentenced the former Mayor of Shenzhen to a two-year suspended sentence for bribery.

translations.baseline: 深圳曾经发生过严重的腐败案件，一些高层官员利用职权为他人谋取利益，大肆敛财，部分涉案官员在政府中担任要职。2002年12月，原深圳海关关长赵玉龙因受贿900万元，被深圳市中级人民法院判处无期徒刑；2003年11月，原深圳市副市长许德立因受贿和滥用职权罪，被广州市中级人民法院判处有期徒刑20年；2005年6月，原罗湖区公安分局局长安雄因受贿罪，被深圳市中级人民法院判处有期徒刑15年；2011年5月，深圳市原市长许宗衡因受贿罪，被郑州市中级人民法院判处有期徒刑2年，缓刑3年。

items.source_text: Conversely, Windows 95 and subsequent operating systems, which provide simple slotting options for multiple users, do not have the concept of access, which makes them broadly equivalent to single-user, single-hub operating systems, meaning that all processes can modify all unopened files and lead sectors, or modify hard disks. This allows viruses and other secretly installed software to be more closely integrated with the operating system, making it difficult for users to detect and remove them. The user profiles in Windows 9x are supported only for convenience. Unless some registration forms are revised, access systems can be “cancelled” at the time of entry, even if all simplified files are protected. Windows 95 default login dialogs allow the creation of new user profiles without access.

items.source_text: On November 17, 1905, Japan signed the Bate Treaty with the Korean Empire, and the Great Korean Empire became Japan’s protectorate. In 1906, Japan established a “headship” in Seoul (Change today). Itomoto became Japan’s first head of the Korean peninsula. In order to preserve the sovereign independence of the Korean peninsula, in 1907, three high-ranking envoys went to the Hague Peace Conference, accusing Japan of aggression and calling for solidarity.

items.source_text: In the same year, the legislature and the legislature discussed the incident. When a wealthy man who did not want to reveal his identity was interviewed by the skylight, the community and the government began to look into the situation. The Rojong and Kowloon Residents’ Association believed that the government should impose sanctions at an early stage, and that the owner and the tenant were forced to pay for the offence. On 9 March, when a journalist visited the city, he said that the government had made a study of the incident and was working with senior officials and Chinese executives.

translations.baseline: 同年，立法會及議會就事件展開討論。當中一名不願透露身份的富商接受《明報》訪問時指，事件發生後，社區及政府開始關注。羅興邦及柯利臣居民協會認為，政府應在早期就作出制裁，對房東及租客作出懲罰。3月9日，當記者訪問柯利臣時，他指政府已對事件作出研究，並與高級官員及中華總商會商討。
translations.opd: 同年，立法会和立法会讨论了这一事件。当一位不愿透露身份的富人接受天光的采访时，社区和政府开始调查此事。罗泾和九龙居民协会认为，政府应在早期阶段采取制裁措施，要求房东和租户为违法行为承担责任。3月9日，当一名记者访问该市时，他表示政府已经对事件进行了研究，并与高级官员和中国执行官合作。

items.source_text: A consular official is an important point of contact between the Government of a country and its citizens residing abroad. Embassies abroad usually establish a consular department and assign diplomatic officers to consular matters. Consular officers are classified as general consuls, consuls, vice-consuls, honorary consuls, etc.

translations.baseline: 领事官员是国家政府与本国驻外侨民联系的重要环节。驻外使馆通常设立领事部门，指派外交官办理领事事务。领事官员分为总领事、领事、副领事、名誉领事等。总领事是领事官员中级别最高的，一般由大使或公使兼任。领事馆一般由总领事、领事、副领事组成。
translations.opd: 领事官员是国家政府与居住在国外的本国公民之间的联系重要点。驻外大使馆通常设立领事部门，并指派外交官处理领事事务。领事官员分为总领事、领事、副领事、荣誉领事等。

items.source_text: The story of Model Identification revolves around a series of films published anonymously and distributed over the Internet. The characters in the book, on various websites, speculate on the identity, motivation, film-making, and inspirational sources of the producers, which coincides with the Internet phenomenon caused by the series of videos that followed in 2006; Gibson himself later denied that his work had had an impact on LonelyGirl15.

translations.baseline: 《模型辨识》的故事围绕着一系列匿名发布的、通过互联网传播的影片。书中的角色在各种网站上对影片的发布者身份、动机、制作过程和灵感来源进行猜测，这与2006年之后由这些影片引发的互联网现象相吻合；吉布森本人后来否认他的作品对《孤独女孩15号》（LonelyGirl15）产生了影响。

items.source_text: The International Youth Day (or International Youth Day) is a United Nations-sponsored festival. The first International Youth Day is on 12 August 2000. In 1999, the United Nations adopted resolution 54/120, which designated 12 August of each year as the International Youth Day. The establishment of the International Youth Day provides an opportunity for Governments to focus on youth issues. On the International Youth Day, various forms of celebration, such as concerts, seminars, cultural events and conferences, are held, usually with the participation of local government officials.

items.source_text: The opposite is the case of non-free software (closed software). If, when a user buys a software package or obtains it free of charge, only “use rights” are obtained, the user must accept the software licence for the software; whereas the original author of the licence specifies that the software retains the right to modify, which is a violation of the licence without the consent of the original author, the software is closed software. Please note that free software also has a licence that is common, such as the GNU General Public Licence, but these licences do not restrict your access to the original code or the modification of the software, the only requirement being that you apply the same or more liberal licences to the modified software.

items.source_text: India is not a mono-ethnic and cultural country, with a multi-religious and multi-ethnic country, with Hindu Hindus accounting for about half of India's population, ethnic Hindus own their own language, ethnic groups have their own scripts, 22 official languages recognized in the Constitution alone, Hindi and English of which are the official languages of the Federation, and the Court has ruled that there is no national language in India; English as a common language is very popular in India, especially in South India. India is also a multi-religious and multi-faith country, known as the “Religious Museum” where Buddhism and Hinduism in the world's main religions are one of the recognized nuclear weapons. India is also a member of many formal and informal multilateral international organizations, including the United States, the World Trade Organization, the Great Britain and Northern Ireland, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation and the Non-Aligned Movement.

items.source_text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Chinese People's Republic of China launched a diplomatic project in 2004, known as the "Anya Project" . Its main objective is to avoid the downgrading of China's World Trade Organization (WTO) name, to engage in classified diplomacy, and to buy Thai nationals who were former Secretaries-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO), at least $600,000 (approximately $50 million). For the Anya Project, in January 2005, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in its “letter from the Secretary-General of the National Security Council”, issued a letter instructing it to send $500,000 to the NSA designated account.

items.source_text: The People's newspaper (Viet Nam:) is an organ of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam, whose purpose is to convey the voices of the “party, nation and people” of Viet Nam. On 11 March 1951, the People's newspaper created a newspaper in the war against French colonialism and inherited the tradition of the newspaper “Youth”, which was founded by Ho Chi Minh. The daily newspaper “People's newspaper” under the banner was issued 220,000 copies, and the 16-page weekend newspaper was distributed 110,000 copies per week; the 48-page “People's Monthly” was published 130,000 copies per issue; the 24-page newspaper “Today” was published on Monday and Thursday, with 50,000 copies.

Truman, announced the Fourth Point Plan for technical assistance to “developing countries” (Point Four Programme), which, because it is the fourth foreign policy objective mentioned in the speech, is called the Fourth Point Plan. items.source_text: Since the popularization of electronic computers, there have been a number of words associated with this paradigm that have entered public life; on the other hand, many new words related to telecommunications have been constructed through a combination of words. For example, “wiki” is a Hawaiian language, but because of the popularization of Wikipedia, the creation of “wikify” (wiki +-fy, wiki); and the creation of “wikification” (wikify, or sequence) from wikify. In addition, one of the novel words used in the database, “serializaability”, is “feasibility to sequence the data to be written in the database” and is derived from another novel, “serial” (sequenced from “serial”, the sequence).

translations.baseline: 自电子计算机普及以来，与这一范型相关的不少词汇已经进入公共生活；另一方面，许多与电信相关的新型词汇则通过词缀组合的方式构造出来。例如，“wiki”是夏威夷语，但因为维基百科的普及，构造出“wikify”（wiki+-fy，wiki的动词形式）；又从wikify构造出wikification（wikify的名词形式）。另外，数据库中使用的新型词汇“serializability”是“将要写入数据库的数据的可串行化”，它来源于另一个新型词汇“serializable”（可串行化，从“serial”（序列）派生）。

translations.baseline: 在影壇方面，王菲憑在《大城小事》中的演出，於1996年瑞典斯德哥爾摩電影節獲最佳女主角獎。導演昆廷·塔倫尼諾曾多次公開讚揚王菲是「天生的演員」，認為她有最優秀的「身體語言」：「只要她在鏡頭前一動，整個畫面都活了起來。」。王菲的演技也獲得其他電影評論家的肯定，如《大城小事》的編劇黃建新認為王菲的演技「很自然，很本色」，而《大城小事》的編劇之一的李碧華則認為王菲的演技「很自然，很本色，很貼近角色」。

items.source_text: During his tenure, Mao was subjected to political persecution and mass cleansing, particularly in his late years, and caused enormous losses in China's spiritual and cultural fields as a result of serious policy mistakes. Three major movements during the early 1950-1953 era of Mao's administration, “Combating the US-Dynasty, land reform, suppression of the anti-revolutionary movement”, the three anti-revolutionary movements of 1951-1952, the anti-right movement of 1957, the leaps of 1958-1962, the cultural revolution of 1966-1976, were estimated to have caused the deaths of 40 million to 80 million people, and tens of thousands of thousands of people were fought and persecuted. Among them, the Cultural Revolution was severely criticized and condemned for having caused a great disaster to the country and its people, China's traditional culture and morality were destroyed, the rule of law and constitutional order were severely undermined, and the cultural revolutions affected the Khmer Rouge massacre in Cambodia.

translations.baseline: 毛澤東在任內曾遭受政治迫害和大規模清洗，尤其是晚年，並因嚴重的政策錯誤導致中國精神文化領域的巨大損失。毛澤東執政初期1950-1953年間的三大運動“抗美援朝、土地改革、鎮壓反革命運動”，1951-1952年間的三反運動、五反運動，1958-1962年間的“大躍進”、大饑荒，1966-1976年間的文革，據估計造成4,000萬至8,000萬人死亡，數萬萬人挨鬥和受迫害。其中文革被嚴厲批評和譴責，認為其對國家和人民造成巨大災難，摧毀了中國的傳統文化與道德，嚴重破壞了法治和憲政秩序，文革的影響甚至波及到柬埔寨的紅色高棉屠殺。
translations.opd: 在毛泽东执政期间，他遭受了政治迫害和大规模清洗，尤其是在晚年，由于严重的政策错误，给中国的精神和文化领域造成了巨大的损失。1950-1953年毛泽东执政初期的三大运动，“反美帝、土地改革、镇压反革命运动”，1951-1952年的三大反革命运动，1957年的反右运动，1958-1962年的跃进运动，1966-1976年的文化大革命，据估计造成了4000万至8000万人的死亡，以及数以万计的人被斗争和迫害。其中，文化大革命被严厉批评和谴责，因为它给国家和人民造成了巨大灾难，摧毁了中国的传统文化和道德，严重破坏了法治和宪法秩序，文化大革命也影响了柬埔寨的红色高棉大屠杀。

translations.baseline: 针对这一大势，史克威尔在电影业失败后采取的救急措施，也向他传达了不妙的讯息：恩ix游戏《勇者斗恶龙》的年中半期利润出现赤字；出版业与《环太平洋》的低迷和《勇者斗恶龙》系列以外的游戏的不景气有关；在亚洲，史克威尔在北美和欧洲的影响力，以及在欧洲的海外业务流程的交换和重组，导致《最终幻想》系列和《勇者斗恶龙》系列的销量急剧下降，为了确保收益，史克威尔不得不采取了停止开发新作的措施；为了准备网络游戏、动作游戏，两家公司的内容被有效利用，以达到两倍的效果。
translations.opd: 针对这一普遍观点，斯凯威尔在电影业失败后采取的救援措施也传达给他关于恩ix游戏冠军在未售出的年度半期利润的脆弱性；出版业与“Ring Up”的衰落以及“Ring Up Dragon”系列之外的游戏的不显眼性有关；在亚洲，斯凯威尔在北美和欧洲的影响，以及在欧洲，海外业务流程的交换和重组，防止了最终幻想系列和龙系列的崩溃，以确保收益，等等；为了准备在线游戏、动作游戏，两家公司的内容被有效利用，以加倍效果。
translations.grpo: 针对这一大势，史克威尔在电影业失败后采取的救急措施，也向他传达了不妙的讯息：任天堂游戏《勇者斗恶龙》的年中亏损半数；出版业与《环太平洋》的低迷和《勇者斗恶龙》系列以外的游戏的不景气有关；在亚洲，史克威尔在北美和欧洲的影响力，以及在欧洲的海外业务流程的交换和重组，导致《最终幻想》系列和《勇者斗恶龙》系列的销量一落千丈；为了确保收益，史克威尔不得不将《最终幻想》系列和《勇者斗恶龙》系列的开发权转让给其他公司；为了准备网络游戏、动作游戏，两家公司的内容被有效利用，以达到两全其美的效果。

items.source_text: The approach is to organize the system more easily than macrokernels, while providing similar features. Microkernels is a logical development of real-time operating systems, usually organized in such a way as to assign nuclear memory within the operating system and switch CPUs across different threads. translations.baseline: 微内核（）是计算机操作系统的一种内核设计，其设计目标是将操作系统内核的大小减小到最小。微内核操作系统将操作系统内核的功能限制在进程间通信、内存管理、中断处理和调度等基本功能上，而将文件系统、用户界面等关键功能放在用户模式的进程中实现。这种方法比宏内核更容易组织系统，同时提供类似的功能。微内核是实时操作系统的一个逻辑发展，通常组织方式是将内核内存分配在操作系统内部，而跨不同线程的CPU切换。用户模式进程实现文件系统、用户界面等关键功能。

items.source_text: Economists generally agree that the CFA franc will eventually be discarded by the members of the franc zone, at least with a substantial change in its operating mechanisms. Economists have devised four alternative options for CFA: (i) negotiating monetary cooperation with the European Union to link the CFA franc to the ECB rather than to the French treasury; (ii) creating a common currency between the West African Economic Monetary Union and the Central African Economic and Monetary Community, with the same basket of foreign currencies (e.g., the United States dollar, the euro, the renminbi); (iii) creating a common currency zone between the West African Economic Monetary Union and other member countries of the Economic Community of West African States; and (iv) gradually establishing a unified currency zone in Africa.

大多数编译器在编译Java语言程序时，生成的都是字节码的“半成品”，运行时在Java虚拟机（解释层）的帮助下，再转换成当前硬件平台的本机代码。之后，Java虚拟机打开标准库和访问数据（图像、线程、网络）。这样，Java程序就可以在任何平台上运行。
translations.opd: 实现跨平台性的方法是，大多数编译器在编译Java语言程序时，生成一个字节码的“半成品”产品，该产品在Java虚拟机（解释层）的帮助下运行，并被转换为当前硬件平台的原生代码。之后，Java虚拟机会打开标准库并访问数据（图片、线程、网络）。

items.source_text: Special drawing rights (SDRs) are denominated in a “basket currency.” Unless the Executive Board decides otherwise, the composition and “weighted” ratio of SDRs is adjusted every five years from 1 January 1986, in accordance with the decision of the IMF of 17 December 1980. For the period 2016-2022, a Special Drawing Right (SDR) = US$ 0.58252 + Euro0.38671 + RMB 1.0174 + JPY 11.9000 + Pound0.085946 (the total value is approximately US$ 1.4 at the 2018 exchange rate). When a member country uses its SDRs, it can convert its SDRs into one of these five currencies.

translations.baseline: 特别提款权的定值采用“一篮子货币”。除非执董会另有决定，根据1980年12月17日国际货币基金组织的决定，从1986年1月1日起，特别提款权的组成和“权重”比例每五年调整一次。2016-2022年期间，1特别提款权=0.58252美元+0.38671欧元+1.0174人民币+11.9000日元+0.085946英镑（按2018年汇率计算，总值约1.4美元）。当一成员国使用其特别提款权时，可以将其特别提款权兑换成这五种货币之一。

items.source_text: Li Dongsheng, representing the Ministry of Central Advocacy of the Communist Party of China as Deputy Director of the Central Office of 610 (2001 - October 2009), as Deputy Director of the Central Office of the Ministry of Information of the Communist Party of China, as Vice-President of CCTV, as well as Vice-Minister of the State of China, as Principal Assistant to Minister Liu Yunshan of Falun Gong, was primarily responsible for the anti-Falun Gong campaign carried out by the main media in mainland China during the four-year period from 1999 to 2002, including CCTV. Li Dongsheng, in his capacity as Special Adviser to the Chinese delegation, was interviewed by journalists at the 57th session of the United Nations Commission on Human Rights and made a thematic statement on women's issues against Falun Gong. Li Dongsheng, in his capacity as Deputy Director of the Unit of the 610 Office of the Ministry of National Security, also spoke as Special Adviser to the United Nations Commission on Human Rights in December 2013, and was sentenced to 15 years in 2016.

items.source_text: The orbital vehicle contains both rocket and vehicle design elements that can be launched vertically as rockets and land as a glider. The airframe is divided into three parts, providing support for crew, cargo, engine and flight manipulation. The main engine module of the space shuttle is at the rear of the orbital vehicle, providing thrust at launch, and the orbital motor system ensuring that the orbital vehicle can enter, replace and withdraw from orbit in space. The triangle is 18 metres long, the inner edge (back of the wing) is at 81°, and the outer edge (back of the wing) is at 45°.
